name: h3.cell_features
description: All features within a given H3 cell at a specific resolution
querySql: SELECT f.id, f.external_id, f.source_table, ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geometry)::jsonb AS geometry, f.attributes FROM tessera.h3_cell_index h JOIN tessera.geo_features f ON f.id = h.feature_id AND f.ingested_at = h.feature_ingest WHERE h.resolution = :resolution AND h.h3_index = :h3CellAddress::h3index ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC
